title: Delta Ordinal Mismatch Transition Discipline

basis.scope: Define disciplined ordinal movement between Delta mismatch classes under declared changes in A, E, <S>, or r_a. The basis is additive and documentary, extending the governed ordinal mismatch layer while leaving RT_core unchanged.

core_rule.statement: Delta may transition between ordinal mismatch classes only under declared changes in A, E, <S>, or r_a; class movement is ordinal and admissibility-sensitive, not numerical distance.

jump_transition.condition: Only when the trace records an explicit discontinuity, substrate or reference change, residue-asymmetry shock, or admissibility failure.

forbidden_inferences: Ordinal class transition does not imply equal interval spacing.
LOW_MISMATCH -> MODERATE_MISMATCH is not assumed to be the same size as MODERATE_MISMATCH -> HIGH_MISMATCH.
Class movement does not imply scalar magnitude.
Class movement does not imply Euclidean distance.
Class movement does not imply physical measurement.
Transition rules do not modify RT_core.

relationship_to_prior_patches.053: Constrains Delta as mismatch/asymmetry evaluation rather than numeric distance.
relationship_to_prior_patches.055: Defines disciplined movement between ordinal classes.

required_repo_changes.description: Add the transition-rule witness that constrains Delta class movement under a declared <S>.
Add the trace schema that records prior and next ordinal classes, changed component, and non-numeric rationale.
Add the counterexample that prevents numeric spacing or distance interpretations of ordinal movement.

success_criteria: Jump transitions require explicit discontinuity or rebinding rationale.
non_claims: Does not define numeric metric values.
Does not define equal ordinal spacing.
Does not define numeric metric values.
Does not define equal ordinal spacing.
